d:
13 navanbar 2026 ko duniya khatm hone ki charcha soshal midiya par tez hai.
Is tarikh ka sanbandh 1960 men prakashit ek vaigyanik adhyayan se hai, jismen ganitiy modal ke aadhar par anuman lagaya gaya tha ki insanon ki aabadi navanbar 2026 men saiddhantik rup se anant yani inphiniti ho sakti hai.
Lekin kya shodhkartaon ne sachmuch duniya ke ant ki bhavishyavani ki thi? kya is tarikh ko koee khagoliy ya prakritik khatra hai? janie is dave ke pichhe ka pura vigyan aur sach.
Riport: majdi al-qassaus, bibisi nyuz arbi
Editing: sadaf khan
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
